description: Live aircraft inside a lat/lon box from the public Flightradar24 feed: callsign, position, altitude (ft), speed (kts), heading, aircraft type, registration, origin/destination airport codes and on-ground flag. Position data is seconds old; the feed does not include every flight worldwide and has no key or history. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
